title: Insignia RTM18 — Test / forced defrost mode entry
description: Enter test mode for forced defrost per §9.7 (freeze + refrigerator gear buttons 3 s).

steps.title: Enter test mode
steps.body: Press and hold the freezer and refrigerator gear buttons together for 3 s, then release. Use the freeze button to select forced defrost. Lock takes effect in test mode.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Keep pressing the Freezing and Refrigerating chamber gear setting button for 3 seconds and release.

steps.title: Forced defrost exit conditions
steps.body: Forced defrost exits when the freezer defrost sensor reaches 8°C and the heater has run ≥ 3 min, or after 60 min heater runtime. Power off or enter standby (hold temp button 3 s) to exit test mode.
steps.sourceExcerpt: In forced defrosting mode, when the freezing defrosting sensor reach a temperature of 8°C and the defrosting heater has been working for at least 3 minutes.
